summary: Dorsey voted against a January 2024 San Francisco Board of Supervisors resolution calling for an immediate and sustained ceasefire in Gaza, one of three supervisors to cast a no vote. In September 2026, he shared an op-ed framing Gaza's post-Hamas future as nation-building and coexistence with a Jewish Israel, calling 'from the river to sea' chants destructive. CAIR-SFBA's tracker separately lists him as opposed to the ceasefire resolution.
